common.tagline: Meet with faith, discernment and privacy.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offlineBody: Your path awaits. Reconnect to continue your conversations.
common.aiTransparency: You are talking to an AI. I accompany your discernment; I never decide for you.

onboarding.s1Body: Not one more swipe. An accompanied journey toward a solid Christian family.
onboarding.s2Title: Six stages, at your own pace.
onboarding.g1Body: Your contact details stay blocked until trust is mutually confirmed. Photo blurred by default.
onboarding.g2Body: An AI coach with spiritual guardrails, and verified human coaches. Never alone in discernment.
onboarding.g3Body: End a conversation with dignity, without ghosting. Respectful words offered at every stage.

auth.consentSensitive: I agree that my religious and family data may be processed to operate the service (sensitive data, GDPR art. 9). It is never sold or used for advertising.
auth.consentTerms: I accept the code of conduct: truth, respect, marriage intention.
auth.verifyBody: A verification link was sent to {email}. In development, the link appears in the server logs.
auth.verified: Email verified. Welcome to the path.
auth.errorEmailTaken: An account already exists with this email.
auth.errorConsentRequired: Both consents are required to continue.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

visibility.explain: From most open to most private · 5 levels

suggestions.title: To discover
suggestions.empty: No new suggestions today. Quality over quantity.

alliance.answerPlaceholder: Your answer, at your own pace…
alliance.requestAdvance: Request to move to the next stage
alliance.advanceRequested: Request sent. Advancing requires both of you to agree.
alliance.advanceDone: You have moved to the {stage} stage.
alliance.exitBody: Choose a respectful message and personalize it if you wish. The other person will be informed gently.
alliance.exitTemplate1: Thank you for our conversations. After reflection, I don't wish to continue, but I sincerely wish you the best.
alliance.exitTemplate2: I prefer to stop here with respect, as I don't feel the alignment needed to continue.
alliance.exitTemplate3: I think our visions of life are different. I'd rather be honest than waste your time.
alliance.exitTemplate4: I need to step back. Thank you for your understanding.
alliance.exitDone: The relationship was closed with respect.
alliance.contactAccepted: Exchange accepted. You may now share your contact details.

messaging.aiSuggestions: Questions suggested by the AI coach
messaging.emptyState: Start the conversation with one of the suggested questions.

aiCoach.subtitle: Discernment accompaniment
aiCoach.guardrailTitle: A question that deserves a human perspective
aiCoach.guardrailBody: I can help you shape your own criteria, but this decision is yours. A human companion can shed deeper light.
aiCoach.guardrailCta: Talk to a verified human coach
aiCoach.quotaReached: You've used your {limit} questions for today. The AI coach returns tomorrow — or talk to a human coach.
aiCoach.fallbackNotice: Guided mode: prepared answers per stage, no external AI.

coaches.title: Verified coaches
coaches.booked: Session requested for {date}. You will receive a confirmation.

curriculum.title: Marriage preparation
curriculum.intro: Six biblical modules, one per stage of the path. To live first on your own, then together: not to pass a test, but to build on the rock.
curriculum.coachCta: Talk it over with a verified coach

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.antiMalaiseDesc: Hides your profile from members of your church and community.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: All your data will be erased: profile, messages, journey, consents. This action is irreversible.

reports.title: Report behavior
reports.reasonPlaceholder: Describe what happened. Your report is confidential and free.
reports.done: Thank you. Our team reviews every report seriously.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.subtitle: Living components — light and dark.
designSystem.toastInfo: You have moved to the Discernment stage.
designSystem.toastWarn: Remember to complete your family vision.

prep.title: Preparation Companion
prep.subtitle: A gentle interview to discern where you are — never an exam.
prep.intro: Five questions, at your pace. At the end: a kind portrait (never a score) and, if helpful, a growth path. You remain free.
prep.consent: I agree that my answers be analyzed by the AI agent to build my preparation portrait (sensitive data, consent revocable at any time).
prep.analyzing: The companion is reading your answers…
prep.neverScore: never a score, never a verdict
prep.overallReady: Your heart seems available for encounter. Go at your pace — the journey will accompany you at every stage.
prep.overallGrowth: Before fully diving in, a season of growth would do you good. This is not a closed door: it is a gift to yourself.
prep.overallHuman: What you carry deserves more than an app: a human companion can help you through this season. We lead you there gently.
prep.growthBody: Guided modules, a verified human coach, and the time it takes. The encounter will wait until you are ready — and it will be all the more beautiful.
prep.growthSkip: I'd rather move at my own pace
prep.humanBody: What you are going through deserves a real presence, not an algorithm. A verified companion can walk with you — without judgment, at your own pace.
prep.banner: New: take your preparation interview — 5 questions to discern where you are.

facil.title: Topics never addressed together
facil.none: All themes of this stage have been opened. Beautiful truth-work.

review.title: My stage review
review.empty: Answer a few stage questions first.
review.private: This review is private — the other person does not see it.

rebuild.cardBody: A relationship has closed. Care for your heart before setting out again — a 4-step path awaits.
rebuild.title: Rebuilding

copilot.title: Prepare the session with AI
copilot.desc: With both your consents, a factual summary of the journey (stage, themes, topics to deepen — never your messages) is prepared for the coach.
copilot.consentLabel: I agree to share this summary with the coach
copilot.waitingOther: Your consent is recorded. The summary will be generated once the other person also consents.

couple.title: Couple Space
couple.subtitle: Covenant life — after the wedding, the path continues.
couple.introNone: Here, the path does not stop at marriage. The first years, a child's arrival, hard seasons: you remain accompanied.
couple.marriedHint: Available once your journey reaches Commitment.
couple.createExternal: We are already married — create our space
couple.joinTitle: My spouse already has a code
couple.inviteBody: Give this code to your spouse: they create an account, then enter it in Couple Space.
couple.pendingConfirm: {name} says you got married. Is it true?
couple.confirmCongrats: May your covenant be blessed. Matching is now disabled for both of you.
couple.checkinPrivacy: Your answers stay private — your spouse never sees them.
couple.confideBody: Need to lay something down, alone or together? The AI coach listens privately — even your spouse has no access — and verified human coaches are there to go deeper.
couple.matchingOff: You are married: your profile no longer appears in matching.
